title: An overriding property may not narrow inherited set visibility

ground_truth.statement: The inherited property allows writes from protected scope. Redeclaring it private(set) narrows that access and violates PHP 8.4 property inheritance visibility rules. PHP rejects the class declaration; a subprocess control with unchanged protected(set) succeeds.

provenance.derivation: Two declarations isolate protected(set) to private(set) override, with PHP minimum 8.4.

notes: Measured on PHP 8.4.26. PHP rejects the fixture with a must-be-protected(set) fatal error. Psalm and Mago diagnose the override, but PHPStan 2.3.1 is silent, retained as FN. The fixture intentionally cannot be loaded successfully; runtime/check.php isolates the fatal in a subprocess.
